title: Lisse equivalence assembled from contractible evaluations
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient sheaf and w-contractible affine T with the component inverse image structures of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], fix a coefficient isomorphism alpha. Given an isomorphism a of terminal section rings and a natural realization square identifying F_S followed by componentDerived with derived scalar extension along a followed by F_T, componentDerived restricts, up to the stated inclusion isomorphism, to an equivalence of the actual lisse full subcategories.

proof.text: The affine spectrum homeomorphism identifies component spaces. W-contractibility makes the spectrum component space extremally disconnected, so both profinite and affine contractible evaluation theorems apply.

Conjugate perfect scalar transport along a by the two evaluation equivalences. Whisker their inclusion isomorphisms with the realization square and cancel the profinite equivalence counit; this gives the required inclusion comparison.

theorem component_lisse_equivalence
    (a : Evaluation.A ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
      (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T)) (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T))) ≅
      Evaluation.A (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)
        (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T)))
    (square : Nonempty (Evaluation.F
        ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
        (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T)) (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T)))
        Over.mkIdTerminal ⋙ componentDerived Λ T α ≅
      RingDerivedScalarExtension.moduleDerivedExtension a.hom.hom ⋙
        Evaluation.F (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)
          (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T))
          (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @AlgebraicGeometry.WeaklyEtale T))) :
    ∃ e : (Evaluation.lisse ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
        (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T))).FullSubcategory ≌
      (Evaluation.lisse (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)).FullSubcategory,
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ (Evaluation.lisse (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
          (condensedRingObj Λ T)).ι ≅
        (Evaluation.lisse ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
          (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T))).ι ⋙ componentDerived Λ T α)
